title: Contents Packout & Storage Declared-Value Coverage Loading for Contaminated Water Losses
content:
Declared-value coverage on Contents Packout & Storage contents from a contaminated water loss carries a loading. For the declared-value coverage of a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job: **when the job's linked mitigation job is a company water job assessed category 3, the black-water coverage loading is added to the valuation percentage; when that water job is assessed category 2, the gray-water coverage loading is added; when the linked mitigation job is a water job assessed category 1, is not a water job, or there is none, no loading is added.**

| Linked mitigation job | Category recorded on that Water Damage Mitigation job | Loading added to the valuation percentage |
|---|---|---|
| a company water job | category 3 | 0.2 (black-water coverage loading) |
| a company water job | category 2 | 0.1 (gray-water coverage loading) |
| a company water job | category 1 | none |
| not a water job, or none | — | none |

The loading is in the same unit as the valuation percentage, percent of the value covered, and is added to it.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Where the valuation percentage were 0.5 (not a tier figure), a category 3 linked water job would make it 0.7 and a category 2 linked water job 0.6.
